name: OpenAI: GPT-6.1 Sol
quirks: Contradictory or vague instructions hurt this family more than most: it spends reasoning reconciling them (provider docs).
tips: State the result wanted, the limits, and what counts as done; leave the path to the model.
Be clear about which actions need approval and when to ask for input.
bench: As the reviewer in QuorX's build benchmark it agreed with the judge 7 of 7 times, at about $0.07 a build (Sonnet 5.5 matched it for $0.02).
